blocks.text: AL AYYAT, Egypt — Two trains collided south of the Egyptian capital on Sunday, derailing several carriages, killing seven people and injuring more than 100 others, according to authorities. Egypt’s railway authority said a train traveling from Giza to Fayoum crashed into the rear of another train heading south from Cairo to the city of Aswan. The Health Ministry said 112 people were injured and were being treated at hospitals in the Giza area.
